QuestInfo.name: Edea's Final Thanks
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001100##k wants to give you something as a show of appreciation for defeating #o8880002#.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001100##k wants to give you a token of her appreciation.

0.0: Your triumph over Magnus has been a boon to our troops. I must give you something, from the heart of my people. Can you come to #b#m401040000##k?

no.0: Heliseum would be all but lost of not for your efforts. Please come and see me when you can.

1.0: Whatever Magnus's ultimate fate may be, he is gone for now, and that is more than we could have hoped for.
1.1: I'd like you to take my supply of Shadowdealer Coins. Please.

yes.0: I'm sure you will put the coins to good use. Just complete #bdaily missions#k from #b#p3001106##k if you want more!
